# SentientDash

> SentientDash provides research, production queues, and account analytics for
> authorized Sentient users.

## Connect ChatGPT

- [ChatGPT dot connection guide](https://sentientdash.app/connect-chatgpt.html):
  Existing plugin link, hosted MCP/OAuth setup, user sign-in and consent,
  verification, and account/workspace availability limits.
- [Markdown connection reference](https://sentientdash.app/connect-chatgpt.md):
  The same connection guidance as plain Markdown for assistants.

This is documentation for a supported host connection flow. It is not an
automatic installation protocol or a grant of account or workspace access.
